textRuns.value: STIntersects, STArea, and the STCentroid trap

dbo.vw_StoreRegionCheck joins each store to a region by GEOMETRY - ON b.Boundary.STIntersects(s.GeoPoint) = 1 - a join on shape rather than on a key. STArea() returns square metres. The gotcha worth the page: geography has no STCentroid() (that is geometry-only, and calling it fails with Msg 6506), so the centre points below come from EnvelopeCenter() instead. The centres are plotted on a scatter rather than a map on purpose: Azure Maps geocodes whatever is in its Location field, and "South" is not a place - it lands in the Atlantic.
